title: Supported Bluetooth Blood Glucose Meters?
symptom: The user asks if there is a complete list of supported Bluetooth blood glucose meters, and mentions that the Contour Next One and OneTouch Select Plus Flex are compatible but use CR2032 batteries that need frequent replacement. They seek a meter with a LiON battery and USB charging, and wonder if the FreeStyle Libre 2 Reader can export data via Bluetooth.
evidence_quote: xDrip implements the Generic Attribute Profile (GATT) for blood glucose meters (BGM), at least partially. Hence, every BGM should be supported if they implement the BGM GATT as well - so far the theory.
